headline: Oil Rises on Iran War Uncertainty Following US Republican Midterm Setback
summary: Oil prices advanced amid ongoing uncertainty regarding talks to end the US-Israeli conflict with Iran, following a Republican electoral defeat.
why: Crude oil is a vital global commodity benchmark; geopolitical tensions in the Middle East directly threaten global energy supplies and shipping lanes.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Geopolitical conflict uncertainty in the Middle East directly drives up crude oil prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Crude prices rose as markets priced in heightened supply risks stemming from Middle East hostilities and shifting US political dynamics.
